description:
Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add:
Expand Mattermost and email tests with real Agent inference/tool iterations, and add full channel E2E journeys against the completed feature. This is one consolidated feature E2E issue covering both channels, not adapter-only or preconstructed Outgoing tests. Exercise channel ingress -> Engine -> Agent/Jido -> retrieval and attach_documents -> StreamEvents -> Executor/Pipeline -> Outgoing -> Channels materialization -> observable channel delivery.
Inspect/reuse test/zaq/channels/mattermost_shared_history_integration_test.exs, test/support/mattermost_history_fixture.ex, test/zaq/channels/email_bridge/outgoing_attachments_test.exs, test/zaq/channels/email_bridge/incoming_attachment_materialization_integration_test.exs, test/support/fake_imap_server.ex, test/support/file_delivery_smtp_stub.ex, and test/e2e/specs/channels.spec.js. These are discovery candidates, not proof of existing full-flow coverage. Confirm exact new/expanded test paths and live service setup before authoring. Use deployed Mattermost and email test endpoints for full E2E; controlled external-edge integration alone does not satisfy the full E2E acceptance criterion.

Tests to add before implementation:
Plan now; author new/expanded feature E2E only after the linked human UX approval. For BOTH Mattermost and email:
1. Within one actual request, drive multiple model/tool iterations: retrieve A, add A, retrieve B, add B, remove A, finish text. Verify only B delivered, correct name/type/bytes and intact answer.
2. Replace selection, including replace([]); verify final exact set or text-only response.
3. Verify selected files are not sent before final completion and removed files never reach upload/send.
4. Cancel or fail after selection; assert no selected file delivery and no leakage to the next request.
5. Repeat calls/replay where controllable and verify no duplicate delivery. Verify a fresh request starts empty; active-request steering causes a later removal before completion.
6. Revoke/deny materialization authorization and verify no unauthorized file delivery; assert the documented text/error outcome without inventing a new delivery contract.
7. Verify correct Mattermost channel/thread and observable post/files; verify email recipient/thread and received MIME attachments/body. No raw handles, private paths or internal Records in visible steps/history.
Exercise real tool calls and stream events; assertions must show the iteration/request identity and final selection. Add focused channel integration regression coverage alongside E2E without weakening existing assertions.

Branches/paths validated:
Both channel entry/exit boundaries; mutation sequence, clear/replace, lifecycle failure, request isolation, authorization and answer/file coordination. Cover configured-agent and default Pipeline propagation in underlying integration tests, with E2E demonstrating real ingress-to-delivery behavior for both channels.

Mocking plan:
Deterministic model responses may script inference/tool turns at the external LLM boundary; execute real Jido runtime, Actions, Engine, Streams, Pipeline and Channels. Local protocol fixtures support integration tests. Full E2E uses controlled real Mattermost/email services and records environment/prerequisites; distinguish fixture-based integration results from deployed-service E2E. Never replace Agent with a canned final answer or inject selected attachments directly. No external production messages; use isolated test accounts/channels/mailboxes.

Documentations to update:
Record precise commands, prerequisites, fixtures, scenario coverage, delivery evidence and failures. Update docs/e2e-testing.md/test guidance when introducing new service setup and docs/services/agent.md if needed. Full E2E stays open when services are unavailable; no silent skip or claim of completion.

Action reuse assessment:
Test expansion only; no new executable product operation. Reuse existing channel ingress/delivery harnesses and the production attach_documents implementation. Investigate existing fixture ownership before adding helpers; production defects return to owning implementation issues.

Approval status:
Pending completed-feature human UX acceptance in the linked gate. User authorized adding this plan, not acceptance of an unimplemented feature. Existing test behavior changes additionally require explicit approval. Follow docs/testing-approach.md, docs/e2e-testing.md and docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md. Completion requires passing both channels' full E2E and recording results; blocks post-review coverage/final feature closure.
title: [zaq-ic9.14.8] Expand Mattermost and email Agent-turn and full E2E coverage
